title: PhysicsToggle
description:
Allow you easy to set physics status of each world.
让您能够轻松设置每个世界的物理状态。
body:
**You can use this plugin to edit and check all your world's physics status easily. If you host a minecraft server for art creator, you may need it. It is equal effect to WorldGuard's /stoplag.**

-  use follow to change physics status
```
/physics toggle [world/all]
```
-  use follows to set it into true or false
```
/physics on [world/all]
```
```
/physics off [world/all]
```

**您可以通过此插件轻松编辑并检查您整个世界的物理状态。如果您为艺术创作者搭建了 Minecraft 服务器，那么您可能会需要它。它的效果与 WorldGuard 的“/stoplag”功能相同。**

-  使用以下指令以切换世界物理状态
```
/physics toggle [world/all]
```
-  使用以下指令以开关世界物理
```
/physics on [world/all]
```
```
/physics off [world/all]
```
